title: A newly created project appears at the top of the project list (sorted by createdAt descending)
steps: Note the current top row of the project list
expectedResult: The just-created project is now the first row — listByOrg/list both sort by { createdAt: -1 }.

title: Total Projects stat increments by exactly 1 immediately after creating a project
steps: Read the 'Total Projects' stats card value
Create a new project via the wizard
Read the 'Total Projects' stats card value again (handleCreateProject triggers a dashboard refetch)
expectedResult: The stat is exactly 1 higher than before, with no double-count and no stale/unchanged value.

title: Changing a project's status from Planning to Active updates the badge color consistently across list and detail views
steps: Edit a 'Planning' (blue badge) project and change its status to 'Active'
Save and view both the project list row and the project detail page
expectedResult: Both views show a green 'Active' badge — getStatusColor is applied consistently and no view shows a stale 'Planning'/blue badge.

title: The search box filters projects by name, project code, or description substring, case-insensitively
description: The backend $or regex filter (list/listByOrg, project.controller.js) escapes the search term via escapeRegExp and matches name, projectCode, and description with the 'i' flag.
preconditions: A project named 'ISO Readiness Sprint' with projectCode 'BKDMVR' exists
steps: Type 'iso readiness' (lowercase) into the search box
Clear it and type 'BKDMVR' (the project code)
Clear it and type a substring known to only appear in the description
expectedResult: All three searches return the same project in the results — matching is case-insensitive and spans name, projectCode, and description.

title: Status and Priority filter tags combine with AND logic to narrow the visible list
preconditions: Projects exist covering multiple Status x Priority combinations, including at least one 'Active'+'High' and one 'Active'+'Low'
steps: Open the filter panel and select Status='Active'
expectedResult: Only projects that are BOTH Active AND High priority remain visible (filteredProjects applies both filters.status.includes and filters.priority.includes as separate AND'd conditions) — an Active+Low project is correctly excluded.
